Iterate through structured table cells and Markdown output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindURI),
		URI:      ptr(`https://example.com/html/simple_table.html`),
		MimeType: ptr(`text/html`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{}
	result, err := xberg.Extract(input, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, table := range result.Results[0].Tables {
		fmt.Printf("%v\n", table.Cells)
		fmt.Printf("%v\n", table.Markdown)
	}
}
```
